### The question

What does a person see in this case, and what should they see? (One sentence.)

### The case

Story id(s), and the preview link from `npm run preview`:

### Proposed answer, and the alternatives

What the case proposes, and what else was considered.

### Who needs to weigh in

People or teams. A case is `status: proposed` until they agree; change it to `accepted` in this pull request when they do.
